caption: Pizzomunno and old town, Vieste
composition: Cliff town above the limestone sea stack · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the cliff path the tall limestone stack of Pizzomunno rises at the left center, its pale flank catching the 08:07 morning sun, with the curved sandy beach sweeping beneath it. The whitewashed old town climbs the cliffs to the right, a dense cascade of flat-roofed houses above the rock face. The Adriatic is calm and turquoise at the left, and scrubby vegetation frames the foreground.
